**Free, open source, and yours to run.** Use Strata on your desktop or with your favorite coding tools. No account needed. ## Models We recommend **ISTA-DASLab first**, then **Unsloth** and other providers, where a compatible model fits.
 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | Provider | Choices | | --- | --- | | **ISTA-DASLab · recommended** | Q2\_0, IQ2\_XS, IQ3\_XXS, IQ3\_S. [Coder: IQ1\_M](docs/MODELS.md#coder) for coding. | | **Unsloth** | UD-IQ4\_XS, UD-Q4\_K\_XL, UD-Q5\_K\_XL, UD-Q6\_K\_XL, Q8\_0 | | **Gyro · agentionai** | [Gyro-S, Gyro-M](https://huggingface.co/agentionai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-GGUF). Lower memory use but slower. | | **Other options** | [Swift 1.5](docs/MODELS.md#swift-15), [NVFP4](docs/NVFP4.md), [OrcaRouter](docs/ORCA.md) | [Compare sizes, memory needs and compatibility](docs/MODELS.md).
 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B **Unsloth:** UD-Q4_K_XL, UD-Q6_K_XL, Q8_0. These are the currently documented packs for this model. [Model guide and compatibility](docs/QWEN36.md).
 DeepSeekV4.1-Flash-1017 In the **desktop app** and the **Terminal**. What does not fit in memory is read from your SSD, so it needs a lot of free disk space. | Set (ISTA-DAS) | Download | Free disk needed | | --- | ---: | ---: | | 1.75 bpw | 239 GB | about 245 GB | | 2.00 bpw | 257 GB | about 265 GB | | 2.25 bpw | 274 GB | about 280 GB | | ISTA-DAS Coder (half of the experts removed) | 191 GB | about 197 GB | Runs on NVIDIA RTX 30, 40 and 50 series (Windows and Linux), AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 (Linux), AMD Ryzen AI Max — Strix Halo (Windows), and Apple Silicon Macs with 64 GB or more, text only ([Mac](docs/DEEPSEEK_MAC.md)). Setup downloads the files and the DeepSeek engine, then starts the model. ```sh strata launch --family deepseek41 --model ist-das-2.00bpw --plan ``` Measured with the 2.00 bpw set on Strata 0.2.5 (Strix Halo: 0.2.7). Output is the speed of the answer, prompt is how fast Strata reads your input. | Hardware | Output | Prompt | | --- | ---: | ---: | | RTX 5070 12 GB, 64 GB RAM | 4 to 6 tokens/s | about 110 tokens/s (4K) | | RTX 3060 12 GB, 46 GB RAM | 9 to 11 tokens/s | about 155 tokens/s (4K) | | 1x Radeon AI PRO R9700, 251 GB RAM | 21 to 25 tokens/s | 320 to 360 tokens/s (8K) | | 4x Radeon AI PRO R9700 | 74 to 77 tokens/s | 400 to 450 tokens/s (8K) | | Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Strix Halo), 128 GB unified | 19 to 21 tokens/s (code), 11 (chat) | 87 tokens/s (4K), 125 tokens/s (8K) | [Memory, disk and details](docs/DEEPSEEK41.md) · [Release notes](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases)
Not sure what fits? [Choose a model for your computer](docs/MODELS.md#pick-by-memory). ## Install ### Desktop app **[Download Strata for Windows, Linux or Mac →](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest)** Install the app, choose a model, and start chatting. There is one installer for each system. On first start the app downloads the engine for your graphics card. [Help with the installer](docs/INSTALL.md#the-app). Files: `Strata-0.2.9-windows-x64-setup.exe` · `Strata-0.2.9-linux-x86_64.AppImage` · `Strata-0.2.9-macos-arm64.dmg`


Chat, files and a live preview in one window.

### Terminal app Prefer the terminal? Install Strata, then run **`strata launch`**.
Install commands **Linux / Mac** ```sh curl -fsSL https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.sh -o install.sh && sh install.sh ``` **Windows PowerShell** ```powershell irm https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex ``` On Windows, open a new terminal afterwards. Then: ```sh strata launch ``` Follow the prompts to download and start a model. [Terminal guide](docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md).


Watch your model and hardware while it runs.
